raw_response:
I farm this small rented piece, and my main crops here are cassava and yam mixed together. At my age, I cannot work as hard as before, but my children and grandchildren help me. Fertilizer is expensive and I do not like to spend money on land that is not mine — for root crops the soil here still carries enough if I add some household manure and ash. I will use my own cassava cuttings and yam setts as I always do, and ask one or two neighbors to help with mounding.
